diagnosis: apply_voucher_to_basket accepts basket_id in the URL path and binds a voucher to the target basket. The view queries Basket.objects.get(pk=basket_id) without validating that basket.owner == request.user. An attacker can bind and consume exclusive single-use vouchers against another customer's basket or tamper with discounts on arbitrary shopping sessions.
